items.title: build.jenesis:build.jenesis.launcher 0.6.5 发布, A bootstrap for executable jars produced by Jenesis. The launcher is shaded into the jar root and runs the bundled application out of the one jars/ store the jar keeps its dependencies in, reading class and resource bytes on demand from the still-open outer jar - nothing is held in memory or extracted to disk. What each path holds is named by META-INF/jenesis/application.properties rather than shown by where a jar sits: what classpath names becomes the unnamed module of a single loader, and what modulepath names is resolved into a fresh java.lang.ModuleLayer mapped to that same loader, preserving full modularity. The same machinery serves a module that keeps a dependency private: it declares a layer, requires this module, and asks for it by name, and the dependency is resolved into a layer of its own - read from the same jar, never relocated and never unpacked.
